     MUST have at least one scenario." The file has others that are fine,
     which is why refusing the whole file has to be a deliberate choice. -->
# lopsided Specification

## Purpose
Holds one requirement that was written without its scenarios.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Written out
The system SHALL do this.

#### Scenario: Doing it
- **WHEN** asked
- **THEN** done

### Requirement: Not written out
The system SHALL also do this, but nobody said when.
